mapper.select: SELECT signup_email_verification_id AS signupEmailVerificationId, email, verification_code_hash AS verificationCodeHash, verification_status AS verificationStatus, failed_attempt_count AS failedAttemptCount, verification_code_expires_at AS verificationCodeExpiresAt, signup_token_hash AS signupTokenHash, signup_token_expires_at AS signupTokenExpiresAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM signup_email_verification WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT signup_email_verification_id AS signupEmailVerificationId, email, verification_code_hash AS verificationCodeHash, verification_status AS verificationStatus, failed_attempt_count AS failedAttemptCount, verification_code_expires_at AS verificationCodeExpiresAt, signup_token_hash AS signupTokenHash, signup_token_expires_at AS signupTokenExpiresAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM signup_email_verification WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT signup_email_verification_id AS signupEmailVerificationId, email, verification_code_hash AS verificationCodeHash, verification_status AS verificationStatus, failed_attempt_count AS failedAttemptCount, verification_code_expires_at AS verificationCodeExpiresAt, signup_token_hash AS signupTokenHash, signup_token_expires_at AS signupTokenExpiresAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM signup_email_verification WHERE signup_token_hash = #{signupTokenHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signup_email_verification ( email, verification_code_hash, verification_status, failed_attempt_count, verification_code_expires_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{verificationCodeHash}, #{verificationStatus}, #{failedAttemptCount}, #{verificationCodeExpiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE signup_email_verification SET verification_code_hash = #{verificationCodeHash}, verification_status = 'PENDING', failed_attempt_count = 0, verification_code_expires_at = #{verificationCodeExpiresAt}, signup_token_hash = NULL, signup_token_expires_at = NULL, verified_at = NULL, used_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email}

UPDATE signup_email_verification SET failed_attempt_count = failed_attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE signup_email_verification_id = #{signupEmailVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE signup_email_verification SET verification_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE signup_email_verification_id = #{signupEmailVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE signup_email_verification SET verification_status = 'VERIFIED', signup_token_hash = #{signupTokenHash}, signup_token_expires_at = #{signupTokenExpiresAt}, verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE signup_email_verification_id = #{signupEmailVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING' AND verification_code_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE signup_email_verification SET verification_status = 'USED', used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE signup_email_verification_id = #{signupEmailVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND signup_token_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND used_at IS NULL
